description: List the user's favorited Resy venues ("hit list").

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands. compact strips image/avatar URLs from the response; "full" returns Resy's payload untouched. No field projection: this server has no verified record of which Resy fields matter, and inventing one would risk dropping a field a caller needs.

name: resy_list_favorites
